[ASSISTANT_SAID] The printing press facilitated the spread of ideas quickly and widely, encouraging debate and discussion that fueled intellectual and cultural advancements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The printing press contributed to the standardization of language, introducing widely accepted spelling, grammar rules, and punctuation, making written communication more accessible.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Increased literacy resulted from the proliferation of printed material, leading to greater cultural advancements as more people learned to read and write.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The printing press had a significant political and religious impact, disseminating ideas related to religious reform and political philosophy, leading to the growth of new movements.
